label: Premium voices: which model speaks them, what it costs, and how a voice id is told apart
description_nl: 2026-09-20 owner: better voices. A voice in voices.json with `paid` set is spoken by this model on the person's OWN key (provider), never by the free edge-tts. Its id starts with voice_prefix, the rest is the model's voice name (Kore, Puck…). usd_per_1m_in / usd_per_1m_out: Google's price per million text tokens in and audio tokens out - edit from the pricing page. chars_per_token, chars_per_second, audio_tokens_per_second: how an estimate is made from the script's characters BEFORE anything is spent (the real usage comes back with every call and is what is booked). sample_rate: the PCM Google returns. any_language: the `lang` a premium voice carries - it speaks whatever language the script is in.
weight_basis: Prices and names of a paid service. Edit them here, never in Python.
